title: Lunar mascons forced Apollo orbit corrections

plain: Hidden concentrations of mass under the Moon's surface, called mascons, pulled on the Apollo spacecraft as they orbited, causing problems with landing that needed corrections. The physicist Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels this without naming a source, as evidence that the Moon's interior is not as simple as it looks.
